scope: Native SSE reasoning-field compatibility; CPU tests with an isolated localhost fake backend

installed_vllm_protocol.verification: Read installed source without importing vLLM or CUDA
installed_vllm_protocol.observation: DeltaMessage.reasoning and ChatMessage.reasoning; serving serializes chunk.model_dump_json(exclude_unset=True) as SSE. No output alias renames reasoning_content.

parser_rule: A valid modern reasoning string wins, including empty string. Otherwise a valid legacy reasoning_content string is used. Neither valid means absent. Visible content remains separate; aliases are never concatenated.

baseline.observed_failure: Timed out waiting for actual native running marker reasoning_delta

coverage: modern-only reasoning SSE refreshes actual native running marker
2.1 second silent stream leaves coordinator marker unchanged
second real reasoning SSE advances marker
worker retries recover while coordinator stream remains active
durable worker identity and recorded tools survive recovery without replay
four concurrent native requests and stable system/tool prefix
durable inbox and sessions survive restart

limitations: This establishes the parser/heartbeat integration defect and its fix. It does not test live-model latency or establish causes of separate historical generation loops.
